human.problem: The question doesn't read grammatically: "So what does Malachi ask why they keep doing to one another?" It also switches to "they", while the verse says "we" and card 1 says Malachi includes himself. No rule covers broken grammar or a pronoun shift inside a paraphrase.
human.question: Should a choice card's question be rewritten when its grammar is broken, for example "So why does Malachi ask they keep doing this to one another?" becoming "Same Father, same God. So what does Malachi ask why we do to one another?" And should it keep the text's "we"?
